sections.title: Inputs And Flex Chain
sections.text: chain required nonempty array of {type:line,length} and {type:bend,radius,angle,axis?} objects; bend axis is x/y/z, default y. outline optional flat polygon (arbitrary 2D outline folding is a gap). stackup optional {neutralLayerFraction} in [0,1] default 0.5. rigidIslands/stiffeners/bendZones optional declared descriptors. schemaVersion required 1. Only declared bend zones bend; the whole outline is never treated as flexible. Neutral-axis length through each bend is radius*angle and is never scaled.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'fpc.fold',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,foldedCenterline:[xyz],mapping:[{index,type,position,tangent,radius?,angle?}],flatNeutralLength,foldedNeutralLength,neutralLengthPreserved:true,neutralLayerFraction,bendArcLengths,scaled:false}. flatNeutralLength equals foldedNeutralLength. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Fold A Declared Bend
examples.requires: Open Design document; a rigid 10 mm lead, a 2 mm-radius 90-degree bend, then a 10 mm tail.
examples.output: result.flatNeutralLength equals result.foldedNeutralLength (10 + 2*pi/2 + 10 in cm) and result.scaled is false.

sections.title: Inputs And Flattening
sections.text: chain required array of {type:line,length} and {type:bend,radius,angle,axis?}. schemaVersion required 1. Bend arcs straighten to segments of radius*angle; the flat neutral length equals the folded neutral length and no scaling is applied.

examples.label: Flatten A Folded Bend
examples.requires: Open Design document; a folded 90-degree bend of radius 2 mm.
examples.output: result.flatNeutralLength is 1 cm + pi*2mm/2 in cm and equals result.foldedNeutralLength.

sections.title: Inputs And Datum Exchange
sections.text: source and target required PCB descriptors each with datum {name,type,origin}; type is mechanical, step-center, lens or pad. schemaVersion required 1. The exchange reports the explicit datum offset and flags a STEP-center vs lens/pad datum mismatch; it never silently adopts a bounding-box center as a lens/pad datum.

examples.label: Step Center Versus Lens Datum
examples.requires: Open Design document; two PCB descriptions with different datum types.
examples.output: result.datumOffset is [0.2,0.1,0] cm and result.compatibleDatum is false; result.warnings notes the STEP-center datum.

sections.title: Inputs And Board Validation
sections.text: board required object with thickness (positive), outline polygon, holes (round/slot with center inside the outline), heightZones (both top and bottom sides required), courtyards and copperKeepouts. schemaVersion required 1. Missing a top or bottom height zone is a violation.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'pcb.check',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,passed,violations,thickness,holeCount,heightZones,courtyardCount,copperKeepoutCount}. status is pass when there are no violations, fail otherwise (executor success:false on fail). Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Valid Board With Both Height Zones
examples.requires: Open Design document; a rectangular board with one in-board hole and both height zones.
examples.output: result.passed is true and result.heightZones contains both top and bottom.

sections.title: Inputs And Port Frame
sections.text: name and frame required; frame has origin [x,y,z], normal unit direction, optional pin1 [x,y,z]. key, matingStroke (nonnegative) and supportZones optional. schemaVersion required 1.

examples.label: Define A Power Port
examples.requires: Open Design document; a port whose normal is +Z with pin1 offset along +X.
examples.output: result.name is PWR, result.normal is [0,0,1] and result.matingStroke is 0.5 cm.

sections.title: Inputs And Poka-Yoke
sections.text: connectors required array of {name,gender,pinCount,key?,shroud?}; intendedPairs required nonempty array of [maleName,femaleName]; forbiddenPairs optional array of pairs that must not mate; insertionOrientations optional pair-to-orientation map; checkScope declared-pairs or full. schemaVersion required 1. Two connectors can reach seating when their pin counts, key and shroud signatures match and genders differ. A forbidden pair that can seat is a poka-yoke violation: similar 4-pin power/data/encoder connectors sharing one key are unsafe, not safe merely because each intended pair mates.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'connector.mate-check',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,passed,status,intended:[{pair,mates,witnessPose}],forbidden:[{pair,canReachSeating,reason}],pokaYokeViolation,checkScope,insertionOrientations}. status is pass only when every intended pair mates and no forbidden pair can seat. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Shared-Key Power And Data Hazard
examples.requires: Open Design document; three 4-pin connectors sharing one key signature, so the wrong pair is physically possible.
examples.output: result.intended[0].mates is true but result.forbidden[0].canReachSeating is true; result.status is fail.

sections.title: Inputs And Shape Fit
sections.text: cavity required outline polygon; items required array of {center,radius} circles or {outline} polygons; reserve optional ratio in [0,1] default 0.3 with denominator cavity area; samplingBudget positive integer default 200000. schemaVersion required 1. Shape fit requires every item to lie within the cavity; equal areas with mismatched shapes do not pass.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'pack.cross-section',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,passed,status,occupiedUnionArea,freeArea,cavityArea,reserve:{actual,required,denominator:'cavity area'},shapeFitViolations,areaFitOnly}. status is pass only when shape fit holds and the actual reserve meets the requirement. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Circle Fits With Reserve
examples.requires: Open Design document; one 2 mm-radius circle centered in a 10x10 mm cavity.
examples.output: result.reserve.actual is close to 1 - pi*4/100 and result.passed is true.

sections.title: Inputs And Keepouts
sections.text: board required object with outline polygon; keepouts required array of {name?,outline,side?} polygons; courtyards optional. schemaVersion required 1. A keepout that extends outside the board outline is a violation.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'keepout.check',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,passed,status,violations,keepouts:[{name,insideBoard,side}],courtyardCount}. status is pass when there are no violations. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: In-Board Copper Keepout
examples.requires: Open Design document; a keepout fully inside the board.
examples.output: result.passed is true and result.keepouts[0].insideBoard is true.
